items.text: Rapoport confirms Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring); Jayden Daniels back/starting for Commanders. Schefter aligns on both.
items.implication: Commanders pass game without Diggs; Daniels return boosts overall offense.
items.opportunity: Targets to McLaurin/others; full Daniels rushing/passing upside.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT on ETR Sunday injury board for Week 5, alongside Tank Bigsby; corroborated by team report and Rapoport/Schefter.
items.why: Final Friday injury report and insider confirmations for London game vs JAX.
items.implication: Eagles RB committee opens fully; heavy usage expected for remaining backs.
items.opportunity: Primary carries and goal-line work to backups like Shipley/Gainwell types.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT on ETR board; Rapoport and Schefter confirm ankle injury sidelines him Sunday vs ATL, Huntley to start.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgraded significantly; Flowers/Andrews/Likely volume shifts under backup.
items.opportunity: Increased checkdowns and red-zone looks to TEs/WRs.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love listed IN on ETR final board, removed from injury report despite ankle maintenance comments.
items.why: Not on final report; player said full-go.
items.implication: Expected to handle primary Cardinals RB role vs DET.
items.opportunity: Workload upgrade projected clear of Allgeier.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT on ETR board with AD Mitchell; Jets backfield and WR depth impacted.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or handcuff elevation for carries.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining RBs in pass/run game.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Michael Pittman both OUT on ETR board; Smith second straight miss, Pittman foot.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets to remaining; Steelers WR depth chart shift.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for Goedert/Wicks types and Steelers alternatives.

items.text: Levitan projects Jeremiyah Love 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much better role this week after Week 4 usage criticism, despite ankle maintenance and long-year downside risk.
items.why: Fan/media drag on prior usage may force larger role; not on final IR; gut says better opportunity.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with clear lead projection; monitor for any late maintenance pull.
items.opportunity: Expanded snaps, carries, routes over committee.
items.conflict: Ankle maintenance and potential coach preference for Allgeier create downside variance.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (plus Alt, James) for Week 5.
items.implication: Ladd McConkey and other Chargers WRs see target bump if active.

items.text: Berry loves Nico Collins @ TEN as his WR8; volume and red-zone work vs soft Titans secondary.
items.why: Target hog with RZ involvement against defense struggling vs WRs.

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; nickname push as 'Brown Gobbler' for gobbling targets/points; workload and matchup driven, ties to Bengals WR injuries.
items.why: Heavy target/carry share vs soft RB defense; potential WR absences boost checkdowns.
items.opportunity: Snaps, targets, carries, RZ work expansion.

items.text: ETR/Levitan discuss Will Shipley show vs JAX following Barkley/Bigsby OUT; primary beneficiary in Philly RB room.
items.why: Barkley and Bigsby absences open full backfield.
items.implication: Shipley (or equivalent) projects for lead role and goal-line.

items.text: Levitan flags multi-risk downside for Malik Nabers long-term: knee issue, lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, and boomer coaching staff; notes recent frustration over targets.
items.why: Stacked injury/QB/coaching concerns plus post-halftime target frustration.
items.implication: Still elite talent but elevated ROS bust risk; monitor practice closely.
items.opportunity: High floor when healthy but volatility rising.
items.conflict: Short-term still strong if active; no designation this week per some reports.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson (WR10 vs DET), Christian Watson (WR15 vs CHI), Isaiah Likely (TE5 @ WSH) on volume/matchup/positional weaknesses.
items.why: Target volume + RZ for Wilson; coverage exploits for Watson/Likely.
items.implication: Strong start candidates in favorable spots.

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle), Mark Andrews (TE17), Cam Skattebo (RB20), Tony Pollard (RB28), Jalen Hurts (QB15 vs JAX London) on tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency, and line issues.
items.why: Matchup/role/efficiency concerns; Hurts rough stretch + banged line; Addison injury.
items.implication: Fade or sit in most formats this week.
